evals.prompt: Here is the Functional Specification Document for a User Management System. Please analyze it and generate the complete technical artifacts including spec_api.md, erd.md (with a DBML block for dbdiagram.io), and task.md.
evals.expected_output: Markdown artifacts: spec_api.md with endpoints and flow logic; erd.md with tables/columns/indexes plus a ```dbml``` block; task.md with dev task cards, story points, dependency fields, and acceptance criteria. Formats should align with references/spec_api_format.md, references/erd_format.md, references/task_format.md. API spec should follow references/api_conventions.md and references/error_catalog.md.

evals.prompt: I need technical specifications from this FSD. Generate the API spec, ERD, and developer tasks.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive spec_api, erd, and task markdown grounded in the FSD; consistent naming across artifacts. Tasks include story points, dependency fields (Depends On, Blocks), and critical path flags.

evals.prompt: Compare this new FSD with our existing ERD and API spec. Produce a Gap Report.
evals.expected_output: Structured Gap Report per references/gap_analysis.md: database changes table, missing endpoints, recommendations. Uses tagged existing files when provided. Should include migration plan outline per references/migration_strategy.md.

evals.prompt: Check consistency between the ERD, API spec, and task cards. List errors and warnings.
evals.expected_output: Consistency Report per references/consistency_check.md with severity columns and fix suggestions.

evals.prompt: We are still discussing scope with the BA. List open questions only — do not write full spec yet.
evals.expected_output: QUESTION_FOR_BA / ASSUMPTION / CONFLICT / DECISION_NEEDED list per references/discovery_questions.md; no premature full spec_api unless user asks to assume.

evals.prompt: Generate PlantUML sequence and class diagrams from this FSD. Only UML, no spec or ERD.
evals.expected_output: PlantUML diagrams only in ```plantuml``` fenced blocks per references/uml_format.md: sequence diagram for API flows, class diagram for entity model. No spec_api or erd output. Entity names consistent with FSD data entities section.

evals.prompt: FSD ini masih draft dan banyak yang belum jelas. List semua pertanyaan dan asumsi — jangan buat spec dulu.
evals.expected_output: Structured question list per references/discovery_questions.md: QUESTION_FOR_BA table, ASSUMPTION table with reasons, CONFLICT if any, DECISION_NEEDED with options and recommendations. All in Indonesian or bilingual. No spec_api/erd/task generated.

evals.prompt: Dari FSD ini, dokumentasikan auth flow, role-permission matrix, dan security requirements.
evals.expected_output: Auth & security documentation per references/auth_security.md: auth pattern selection, JWT token spec, role-permission matrix table, brute force protection rules, password policy, rate limiting, data protection rules. Error codes for auth failures per references/error_catalog.md.

evals.prompt: Generate frontend task cards from this FSD. Include component breakdown, API integration, and acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: FE task cards per references/frontend_task_format.md: screen/page identification, component breakdown table, API integration table (action, method, endpoint, trigger), state management table, UI states (loading, empty, error, success), acceptance criteria checklist. Each task has story points.

evals.prompt:
Generate development timeline with Gantt chart from these task cards. Assign to 3 developers (1 senior, 1 mid, 1 junior) and estimate story points.

@task_user_management.md
evals.expected_output: Timeline estimation per references/timeline_estimation.md: estimation summary (total SP, hours, sprints, weeks), sprint breakdown with task assignment, critical path identification, developer utilization bars, auto-detected risks/warnings. Self-contained HTML file (timeline_user_management.html) with interactive Gantt chart, color-coded by developer, dependency visualization. 1 SP = 4 hours.

evals.prompt: Tolong buat migration plan untuk perubahan database yang ditemukan dari gap analysis FSD ini vs existing ERD.
evals.expected_output: Migration plan per references/migration_strategy.md: severity classification per change (safe/moderate/dangerous), zero-downtime phase approach, data migration scripts with SQL, rollback plan with triggers, deployment sequence with owners and verification steps. Error codes for auth failures per references/error_catalog.md.

evals.prompt: Generate RTM dari FSD dan artifacts yang sudah ada. Output ke output/rtm/RTM.md
evals.expected_output: Requirement Traceability Matrix per references/rtm_format.md: exactly one file output/rtm/RTM.md with Business Requirements (BR), Design Solutions (DS), Test Cases (TC), and Functional Requirements (FR) tables. Every FR references a BR; DS/TC cells reference codes (semicolon-separated if multiple); sequential IDs; Indonesian titles/descriptions, English technical terms; empty cells left for requirements with no design or test yet.

evals.prompt: Generate RTM untuk scope BRD01_P2 (FD customer + product) dari input/fsd/BRD01_P2_*.md
evals.expected_output: Scoped RTM per references/rtm_format.md: exactly one file output/rtm/RTM_BRD01_P2.md covering only the selected FDs (customer, product). IDs restart at BR-001/FR-001/DS-001/TC-001 for this scope; output/spec|erd|task filtered to the selected features; every FR references a BR.

evals.prompt: Generate openapi.yaml dari semua spec yang ada
evals.expected_output: OpenAPI 3.0 per references/openapi_format.md: exactly one file output/spec/openapi.yaml with all endpoints merged from MASTER_SPEC_API.md + output/spec/*.md, unique paths, per-operation summary/description/tags, requestBody/parameters where mentioned, x-status (done|in-develop) and x-phase when derivable. Valid parseable YAML.

scripts_smoke.description: Validate sample spec if path provided
scripts_smoke.note: sample_fsd is FSD not spec — expect WARNs; use a real spec_api.md for green OK
